_note: Official online destinations for the City of Mati, each opened on checkedOn. kind: website (a City Government site or page), service (an online service the City runs), social (an account the City's own website links to), national (a national-government portal that covers Mati). A link appears here only if it opened when checked.

links.name: City Government of Mati — official website
links.purpose: The City's own website: news, the Mayor's page, the Sangguniang Panlungsod and the list of departments.

links.name: Departments and offices
links.purpose: The City's list of its departments and offices.

links.name: Office of the City Mayor
links.purpose: The Mayor's page on the City website.

links.name: Sangguniang Panlungsod
links.purpose: The City Council's page on the City website.
links.note: The council has no separate website: sangguniangbayan.mati.gov.ph, linked by earlier versions of this site, does not exist.

links.name: City news
links.purpose: News and announcements posted on the City website.

links.name: TrabaWho Mati
links.purpose: The City's job portal: register, search job openings and apply online.

links.name: City Government of Mati on Facebook
links.purpose: The City's Facebook page, as linked from the City website. Advisories and announcements are often posted here first.

links.name: Full Disclosure Policy Portal
links.owner: Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)
links.purpose: Where local governments, Mati included, post their required budget, procurement and fund reports.

links.name: PhilGEPS bid notices
links.purpose: The government's procurement notice board, including the City's open bids.

links.name: Bureau of Local Government Finance
links.purpose: Publishes local government income and spending reports and supervises local treasurers and assessors.

links.name: Cities and Municipalities Competitiveness Index
links.purpose: Yearly competitiveness rankings and data for cities and towns, including Mati.

links.name: eFOI portal
links.purpose: Freedom of Information requests to national government agencies.
links.note: Under maintenance when checked; the portal points to an interim way to lodge a request.

links.name: Open Data Philippines
links.owner: Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT)
